build_wikitext_vocab: run the script to build a wikitext vocabulary from the train dataset and write it to a CSV file
build_graph_vocab: run the script to build a graph vocabulary from node and edge tokens and write it to a text file
build_text_vocab: run the script to build a text vocabulary from the graph-to-text paired dataset and write it to a CSV file
get_vocab: call get_vocab with a RawDataset to get a sorted list of word count tuples from the training data
write_vocab: call write_vocab with a list of word count tuples and an output path to save the vocabulary as CSV
